items.title: GitHub Copilot 推出 HydraFusion 项目，依托多模型路由实现前沿级性能
items.summary_zh: GitHub 为 Copilot 推出研究预览项目 HydraFusion，把多模型调用做成运行时路由：按任务复杂度在单模型直答、级联升级、独立模型评审三种模式间切换，并配套成本计账、超时取消与回退机制。其离线评测中，TerminalBench 2.1 上的质量比 Claude Opus 5 高 4.9 个百分点、预估成本低 67%。目前通过 Copilot CLI 的 /experimental 对所有层级用户开放。
items.summary_en: GitHub has launched HydraFusion, a research preview for Copilot that treats multi-model orchestration as a runtime routing problem, sending each task to single-model direct execution, a cascade that escalates to stronger models, or an independent reviewer model, all backed by token accounting, timeouts and fail-safe rollback. In offline tests it beat Claude Opus 5 on TerminalBench 2.1 by 4.9 points at 67% lower estimated cost, and on the internal CheckpointBench matched it within 0.1 points at 65% less cost. It is open to all Copilot tiers through the CLI's /experimental flag.

items.summary_en: OceanBase's Data Agent entry, internally codenamed Scout, topped the Data Agent Benchmark (DAB) with 90.62% accuracy, the first submission to clear 90%, and it runs on the domestic GLM-5.2 model rather than GPT or Claude. DAB, run by UC Berkeley's EPIC Data Lab with Hasura PromptQL, evaluates the full chain from understanding scattered data to planning, querying and verifying answers. The capability will be folded into OceanBase DataPilot.

items.title: 纯 LLM 做 NL2SQL 总不准？金融场景为什么必须做本体工程
items.summary_zh: 文章用一个金融问数的生产案例说明，纯 LLM 的 NL2SQL 方案按概率生成 SQL，无法确定“有效保单”究竟对应 status_code=1 还是 status_flag='Y'，一旦映射错误结果就是静默错，业务方很难察觉。作者据此梳理固定报表、自助 BI、AI 问数、本体驱动认知智能四个阶段，论证需要引入本体作为统一查询口径的“语义导航系统”，对做强准确度问数产品的工程团队有参考价值。
items.summary_en: This fintech-focused write-up explains why plain LLM NL2SQL keeps returning wrong numbers: the model has to guess whether "active policy" means status_code=1 or status_flag='Y', and when it guesses wrong the query still runs, producing silent errors nobody notices. It traces four stages of analytics tooling — fixed reports, self-service BI, AI querying, ontology-driven reasoning — and argues an ontology is needed as a semantic navigation layer. Relevant for teams building data Q&A in accuracy-critical domains.

items.title: [分享创造] wmux： Windows 上的 tmux，终端多路复用
items.summary_zh: wmux 是作者用 Rust 写的 Windows 版 tmux，直接跑在 Windows 原生 ConPTY 上，单个 3 MB exe 下载即用，沿用了 tmux 的 C-b 分屏、hjkl 切换快捷键，并能让 PowerShell、cmd、WSL 同处一个窗口的不同 pane。关掉终端后任务继续运行，wmux attach 接回现场，wmux resume 可恢复窗口布局、各 pane 的命令与所在目录，还支持 activity 提示和 remain-on-exit 保留崩溃 pane；现成 .tmux.conf 基本能用。
items.summary_en: wmux is a Rust reimplementation of tmux for Windows that runs directly on the native ConPTY and ships as a single 3 MB executable with the usual C-b keybindings. It keeps PowerShell, cmd and WSL sessions alive after you close the terminal — attach reconnects, resume restores layouts, running commands and working directories — and adds activity markers plus remain-on-exit so crashed panes stay on screen instead of vanishing. Existing .tmux.conf files mostly work unchanged.

items.title: trycua/cua
items.description: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
items.author: trycua
items.summary_zh: Cua 是一套面向 computer-use agent 的开源工具，包含桌面自动化驱动、隔离的云端桌面、本地 macOS VM、专用决策模型，以及用于训练、评测和数据生成的 benchmark。它同时提供 Cua Fleets，可跨操作系统批量管理这类 agent，适合需要训练或评估 computer-use agent 的团队。
items.summary_en: Cua is an open-source stack for computer-use agents: desktop automation drivers, isolated cloud desktops, local macOS VMs, specialist decision models, and benchmarks for training, evaluation and data generation. It also ships Cua Fleets for managing such agents across cross-OS fleets. Targeted at teams that need to train or evaluate agents operating real computers.

items.title: MosMos
items.description: Voice writing that works before, during, and after meetings
items.summary_zh: MosMos 是 Product Hunt 上的一款语音写作工具，官方描述称其覆盖会议前、会议中和会议后三个阶段。目前对外披露的只有这一句定位，没有更具体的功能或价格信息，关注会议记录与语音输入效率的人需要到产品页进一步确认。
items.summary_en: MosMos is a Product Hunt launch described as voice writing that works before, during, and after meetings. That one-line pitch is the only detail available here, so anyone interested in voice input across the whole meeting workflow will need to check the product page for specifics.

items.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
items.description: A framework for building agentic apps
items.author: BuilderIO
items.summary_zh: Agent-Native 是 BuilderIO 开源的 TypeScript 框架，用来构建“自主执行＋配套 UI”的 agent 应用：每个能力只需声明一次 action，agent 把它当 tool 调用，UI 则在代码里复用同一个 action，避免工具层和界面层各写一套。README 给出的快速上手命令是 npx @agent-native/core create my-agent --standalone --template chat，适合想同时交付 agent 行为和交互界面的团队。
items.summary_en: Agent-Native is an open-source TypeScript framework from BuilderIO for building agents that pair autonomous work with a purpose-built UI. Each capability is declared once as an action, which the agent uses as a tool and the UI calls from code, so the two layers don't diverge. The README's quick start is npx @agent-native/core create my-agent --standalone --template chat; it targets teams that want to ship agent behavior and its interface together.

items.title: [程序员] 为啥 codex cli 总莫名其妙停工， DSH 和 Trae 没事
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者反馈，在 cc switch 搭配 codex 和中转站 API 的同一套 KEY 配置下，Codex CLI 会毫无规律地在任务中途停下，需要反复催促才继续，而 DSH 和 Trae 能长时间不间断运行，且这种停止并非连接中断或报错码。他在帖中询问是否有相关设置可以解决，原文没有给出确定原因或解决方案。
items.summary_en: A developer reports that Codex CLI keeps stalling mid-task under the same API key and cc switch setup, needing repeated nudges to resume, while DSH and Trae run uninterrupted for long stretches — and these stops are not connection drops or error codes. The post asks whether any setting can fix the behavior; the thread offers no confirmed cause or workaround.

items.title: Sider Omni Sidebar
items.description: Give every Mac app an Agent Sidebar
items.summary_zh: Sider Omni Sidebar 是一款面向 macOS 的工具，宣称能给每个 Mac 应用加上一条 Agent 侧边栏，让 AI 助手在你正在用的任意软件里直接调用。Product Hunt 页面目前只有这一句简介，支持的模型、定价和权限机制都没交代，适合想在日常 Mac 工作流中随处唤起 Agent 的人先观望。
items.summary_en: Sider Omni Sidebar is a macOS tool that promises to give every Mac app an Agent sidebar, so an AI assistant is reachable from inside whatever you're working in. The Product Hunt listing offers only that one-line description — no word yet on supported models, pricing or permissions — so it's one to watch for people who want an agent everywhere in their Mac workflow.

items.title: Mycel
items.description: Bring one past deliverable. Mycel drafts every future one.
items.summary_zh: Mycel 是 Product Hunt 上的一个工具，官方描述称只需导入一份过往的交付成果，它就能据此起草之后的每一份交付物。目前公开信息基本只有这句简介，具体机制未说明；适合需要反复产出同类文档、想减少重复劳动的人自行了解。
items.summary_en: Mycel is a Product Hunt tool whose tagline says you bring in one past deliverable and it drafts every future one. That tagline is essentially all the public information provided here, so the underlying mechanism isn't spelled out; it may appeal to people who repeatedly produce the same kind of document.

items.title: I built non-autoregressive decision models with RL a year ago
items.author: nandakishor_ml
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者表示自己在一年前用 RL 做出了非自回归的决策模型：单次前向传播即可覆盖 100 多种语言，在 GPU 上耗时约 33ms，基于 RLCD 与 proper scoring rules 构建，来自 Convai Innovations。这类做法的看点是绕开逐 token 生成，把多语言推理压进一次前向计算里。
items.summary_en: A developer says he built non-autoregressive decision models with RL a year ago: one forward pass covers 100+ languages at roughly 33ms on GPU, built with RLCD and proper scoring rules by Convai Innovations. The point is skipping token-by-token decoding and folding multilingual inference into a single pass, which matters to anyone dealing with latency-sensitive models.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者在掘金记录了从 Cursor 转向 Codex 大半个月的真实感受。他称 Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 让他觉得 AI 更像是能自主完成任务的超级 Agent，形态上更接近下一阶段，适合正在两者间权衡的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: A developer on Juejin shares impressions after switching from Cursor to Codex for roughly half a month. Cursor, they write, delivered the first strong shock of AI-assisted coding, while Codex felt less like a coding assistant and more like a genuine super-agent, closer to the next stage. Useful for developers weighing the two tools.

items.title: coder/coder
items.description: Secure environments for developers and their agents
items.author: coder
items.summary_zh: coder/coder 是一个可自托管的云开发环境平台，主打为开发者和他们使用的 AI agent 提供安全环境，工作区跑在团队自己掌控的基础设施上。仓库提供文档、Discord 社区，并区分出付费的 Premium 方案，适合需要统一管理开发环境、或想给编码 agent 划出隔离边界的平台与基础设施团队评估。
items.summary_en: coder/coder is a self-hosted platform for cloud development environments, pitched as secure environments for developers and their agents, so workspaces run on infrastructure the team controls. The repo ships with documentation, a Discord community and a paid Premium tier, making it worth a look for platform and infrastructure teams that want to standardize dev environments or sandbox coding agents.

items.title: anthropics/financial-services
items.author: anthropics
items.summary_zh: anthropics/financial-services 汇集金融行业的参考 agents、skills 与数据连接器，覆盖投资银行、股票研究、私募股权和财富管理，同一套 system prompt 既可装成 Claude Cowork 插件，也能经 Claude Managed Agents API 部署。其中 Pitch Agent、GL Reconciler 等只起草模型、备忘录和调节表，仓库明确声明不构成投资建议，输出需人工签核。
items.summary_en: anthropics/financial-services is Anthropic's reference collection of agents, skills and data connectors for investment banking, equity research, private equity and wealth management. The same system prompt and skills run either as a Claude Cowork plugin or through the Claude Managed Agents API. Agents like Pitch Agent and GL Reconciler only draft models, memos and reconciliations; the repo stresses this is not investment advice and every output needs human sign-off.

items.title: Android 17 is the first since 3.x to add new APIs without releasing to the AOSP
items.author: theanonymousone
items.summary_zh: Android 17 QPR1 成为自 Android Honeycomb (3.x) 以来首个在没有向 AOSP 发布的情况下就为应用开发者新增 API 的版本，这些新 API 目前只在 Pixel OS 上提供，其他 Android OEM 拿不到（见官方 API diff 37.1）。对依赖 AOSP 或非 Pixel 设备做开发和测试的团队来说，API 可得性会明显分化。
items.summary_en: Android 17 QPR1 is the first release since Android Honeycomb (3.x) to add new APIs for app developers without a matching release to the Android Open Source Project, according to the linked API diff 37.1. Those APIs currently ship only in Pixel OS and aren't available to other Android OEMs, so anyone targeting non-Pixel devices can't count on them yet.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 掘金一篇面向面试的文章讨论“AI 已能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你”。作者称 2026 年的技术面试已与两年前不同：过去考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认你会用 AI，考察点随之转移。适合准备面试或负责招聘的开发者，但给出的摘要在此截断，未展开具体答案。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article tackles the interview question "AI can already write 80% of the code, so why does the company still need you?" It contrasts 2026 interviews with those two years ago, when candidates hand-wrote a Promise or explained React Fiber internals; today interviewers assume AI use and probe something else. Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

items.title: 如何看待中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《关于分类推进高校改革的意见》？
items.summary_zh: 知乎上有人就中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《关于分类推进高校改革的意见》发起提问。该条目原文是链接，未提供更多细节，因此除发文机关和“分类推进高校改革”这一主题外无法确认具体条款；关心高等教育政策的人需要去看原始文件。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu question asks how to view the "Opinions on Advancing University Reform by Category," issued jointly by the General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the issuing bodies and the topic of categorized higher-education reform aren't available, so readers should consult the original document.

items.title: Bolt Forge
items.description: Bolt's new agent with open-source models and 50X usage
items.summary_zh: Bolt 推出名为 Bolt Forge 的新 agent，底层改用开源模型，官方给出的用量额度是此前的 50 倍。对在意编码 agent 调用成本和模型可替换性的开发者来说，这等于把预算上限大幅放宽，同时不必绑定单一闭源模型。
items.summary_en: Bolt Forge is a new agent from Bolt that runs on open-source models and comes with what the team describes as 50X usage. That combination matters for developers who want agentic coding without being tied to one proprietary model or squeezed by a tight usage cap.

items.title: 大一新生军训跑去旅游，网传学校报警寻人、教官被取消留役资格，校方回应该生正办理退学手续，如何看待此事？
items.summary_zh: 知乎讨论的是一起高校事件：一名大一新生在军训期间外出旅游，网传学校报警寻人、相关教官被取消留役资格，校方回应称该生正在办理退学手续。原文是链接，未提供更多细节，目前只有标题层面的这些说法。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu thread discusses a university incident: a freshman reportedly went traveling during military training, with unverified claims that the school called police to find the student and that the instructor lost eligibility for continued service, while the school said the student is processing withdrawal. The linked page isn't summarized here, so only the headline claims are available.

items.title: Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
items.description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
items.author: Crosstalk-Solutions
items.summary_zh: Project NOMAD 是 Crosstalk-Solutions 开源的离线优先知识与教育服务器，内置维基百科、数千本书籍、课程、地图和可选的本地 AI，全部运行在自有硬件上、无需联网。它支持 Debian 系系统，推荐 Ubuntu 26.04 LTS，也兼容 24.04 LTS 与 Debian 12，安装全程在终端完成、通过浏览器访问，适合断网环境或自建资料库的场景。
items.summary_en: Project NOMAD from Crosstalk-Solutions is an offline-first knowledge and education server bundling Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required. It installs on Debian-based systems, with Ubuntu 26.04 LTS recommended and 24.04 LTS plus Debian 12 supported, is set up entirely in the terminal and browsed over the web. Aimed at offline or self-hosted knowledge needs.

items.title: Minicart
items.description: Launch your store. Let AI run the busywork.
items.summary_zh: Minicart 是 Product Hunt 上新发布的一款开店工具，一句式介绍是「上线你的商店，让 AI 处理繁琐杂事」，即用 AI 接管建站后的重复性运营工作。该条目只提供了这句宣传语，支持哪些渠道、如何计费等信息原文并未给出，想评估的人需要自己去官网看。
items.summary_en: Minicart is a new Product Hunt launch pitched as a way to get a storefront online and let AI handle the repetitive work around it. The listing offers only that one-line description, so supported platforms, pricing and how the automation actually works aren't specified here; anyone shopping for an AI-assisted commerce tool will need to check the site itself.

items.title: Nvidia announces native GPU programming in Rust
items.author: nonmaskable
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣布将推进 Rust 原生 GPU 编程，同时表示 CUDA C++ 与 CUDA Python 已经是成熟的企业级工具链。现有素材只有正文开头一段，Rust 支持的具体范围、发布时间和 API 形态均未提及。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA says it is leaning into native GPU programming in Rust, while noting that CUDA C++ and CUDA Python are already mature, enterprise-grade toolchains. Only the opening paragraph of the piece is available here, so the scope of the Rust effort, its timeline and its API surface aren't described.

items.title: Answers by Context.dev
items.description: Give it a research task + the JSON shape you want back.
items.summary_zh: Answers by Context.dev 是一款按指定格式返回结果的调研工具：你给它一个研究任务外加想要的 JSON 结构，它按这个形状把答案交回来。对需要把调研输出直接喂给程序、而不是读一段自然语言的开发者（例如做数据管道或 agent）比较实用，条目未提及价格和接入方式。
items.summary_en: Answers by Context.dev takes a research task plus the JSON schema you want back and returns the answer in exactly that shape. That suits developers wiring research into pipelines or agents that need structured output rather than prose; the listing doesn't explain pricing or how you'd integrate it.

items.title: Vibe Coding 时代：Vue 消失了还是 React 太强？
items.description: Vibe Coding 时代：Vue 消失了还是 React 太强？ 作者：吴佳浩 撰稿时间：2026-3-28 最后更新：2026-3-30 引言： 最近一段时间，“vibe coding” 的项目
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在Vibe Coding（基于AI情绪化编码）时代，Vue和React两大前端框架的地位变化。作者分析了为何有人认为Vue逐渐式微而React愈发强势，并指出AI编程工具可能更倾向于与React生态兼容。文章引发读者思考：在AI辅助编码日益普及的今天，前端开发者应如何选择技术栈，以及Vue是否真的面临生存危机。
items.summary_en: This article explores the shifting status of Vue and React in the era of Vibe Coding, where AI-assisted development is driven by mood and flow. The author analyzes why some believe Vue is fading while React grows stronger, noting that AI coding tools may favor React's ecosystem. It prompts readers to think about how frontend developers should choose their stack and whether Vue truly faces an existential threat as AI-assisted coding becomes mainstream.

items.title: Cloudflare Quick Tunnels
items.author: jcbhmr
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 的 Quick Tunnels 用一条免费加密隧道把本地 localhost 服务发布到公网，不需要注册账号、配置 DNS 或开放入站端口。适合临时要给同事演示本地 Web 服务、调试 webhook 回调或在远端设备上验证页面的开发者。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare Quick Tunnels expose a localhost service to the public internet over a free encrypted tunnel, with no account, DNS record, or open inbound port required. It fits developers who need a throwaway public URL for demos, webhook callbacks, or checking a local page from a remote device.

items.title: Mantra Timer
items.description: A minimalist mantra meditation timer for iOS.
items.summary_zh: Mantra Timer 是一款面向 iOS 的极简咒语冥想计时器，用来给念诵或冥想计时。它强调界面简单、不带多余功能，适合只想要一个安静计时工具、不需要完整冥想课程 App 的人；条目本身没有提供更多细节。
items.summary_en: Mantra Timer is a minimalist iOS timer built for mantra meditation sessions. It targets people who want a bare-bones interval tool rather than a full meditation app with courses and social features; the listing doesn't go beyond that description.

items.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
items.description: AutoClip : AI-powered video clipping and highlight generation · 一款智能高光提取与剪辑的二创工具
items.author: zhouxiaoka
items.summary_zh: AutoClip 是一款开源桌面工具，用 AI 从长视频中自动提取高光片段并剪辑成适合分享的短片，作者将其定位为「二创」工具。项目采用 MIT 协议，提供 macOS（Apple Silicon）桌面安装包，README 覆盖中、英、日、韩、西班牙语等八种语言，适合需要批量产出短视频切片的创作者。
items.summary_en: AutoClip is an open-source desktop app that uses AI to pull highlight moments out of long videos and cut them into shareable shorts, positioned by its author as a tool for re-editing existing content. It ships under the MIT license with a macOS Apple Silicon installer and READMEs in eight languages including English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, so it's aimed at creators producing short clips in bulk.

items.title: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
items.author: lmbbuchodi
items.summary_zh: 有开发者指出 OpenAI 通过 bzr.openai.com 设置一枚名为 __obi 的 cookie（作用域 .openai.com），当用户访问那些在 ChatGPT 上投放过广告的网站时，该标识会被回传，从而把站外浏览和购买行为与 ChatGPT 账号关联起来。作者称已在手机上复现整条链路，并用两种独立抓包方法交叉核对了覆盖 936 个广告像素、1029 个主机名的流量数据。
items.summary_en: A developer reports that OpenAI sets a cookie named __obi from bzr.openai.com, scoped to .openai.com, and that ordinary sites which buy ads on ChatGPT send it back to OpenAI, letting the company tie off-site browsing and purchase behavior to a ChatGPT account. The author says he reproduced the mechanism on his own phone with two independent capture methods and cross-checked traffic covering 936 advertiser pixels across 1,029 hostnames.

items.title: How to Write with an LLM
items.author: joeriddles
items.summary_zh: 这篇短文提出用 LLM 写作的两条原则：不要采纳它建议的任何措辞，也不要接受它的鼓励，然后把繁琐的活儿全部交给它。适合想借 AI 提效、但不愿让自己的文字风格被抹平的写作者。
items.summary_en: A short piece arguing that two rules keep an LLM from flattening your prose: never take a word it suggests, and never let it encourage you, then hand it all the tedious work. It speaks to writers who want AI's speed without losing their own voice.

items.title: 如何看待新华社新闻「公然侮辱诋毁乒乓球、跳水运动员，多人被罚！」？
items.summary_zh: 这是知乎上的一个讨论提问，围绕新华社一则报道展开——有人因公然侮辱、诋毁乒乓球和跳水运动员而被处罚。该条目只有标题，原链接未提供报道正文、涉及人员或处罚细节，无法据此展开更多。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu discussion thread asking how to read a Xinhua report that several people were penalized for publicly insulting and defaming table tennis and diving athletes. The item carries only the question title; the linked page isn't summarized here, so no case details are available.

items.title: Qwen Image 2.1
items.author: jmillikin
items.summary_zh: Hacker News 上关于 Qwen Image 2.1 的帖子，随附说明只笼统列出 Qwen 的能力范围，涵盖对话、图像与视频理解、图像生成、文档处理、联网搜索、工具调用和 artifacts。对 2.1 这个版本本身，条目里没有给出参数、发布时间或评测信息。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News post titled Qwen Image 2.1, whose accompanying description only lists Qwen's broader feature set: chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use, and artifacts. items.title: 三年了，AI为何还没有抢走程序员饭碗？

items.summary_en: This Chinese tech commentary revisits the three-year-old claim that AI will take programmers' jobs. It argues that even as AI has iterated to Claude 5 and GPT-6, the anticipated wave of mass layoffs still hasn't happened. Useful reading for developers reconsidering 'AI replaces coders' narratives.

items.title: 被吹上天的 JWT，为什么主流网站一个都不用

items.summary_zh: 文章以 github.com 为例：开发者工具里只有一条 _gh_session，是一串 Rails 框架加密后的会话数据，作者借此说明主流网站为何不把状态塞进 JWT，而继续用服务端会话 Cookie。适合正在为鉴权方案选型、想知道 JWT 在真实系统里到底卡在哪里的后端开发者。
items.summary_en: Using github.com as the example, the author notes its cookies contain just a single _gh_session value — Rails-encrypted session data — to explain why mainstream sites keep state on the server rather than packing it into a JWT. It is aimed at backend developers choosing an authentication strategy and wondering where JWTs actually fall short in production.

The author is upfront about the trade-offs: inference speed, memory footprint and long-task experience remain real barriers. It suits developers willing to run local inference who can live with slower responses.

items.summary_zh: 文章从1800年前后一名英国手工织工讲起：他靠脚踏织机、手推梭子维生，价值全在一双手上，直到工厂里出现了新的织布机器。作者用这段历史类比当下 AI 对程序员的冲击，讨论技术替代与技能贬值。适合关心 AI 对职业前景影响的开发者阅读。

Aimed at developers weighing AI's effect on their careers.
